description: This file defines a class named 'Statistics' in the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Event'. The class extends a system controller and includes methods for logging and updating statistical data related to review addition, return addition, order status updates, and sale totals within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The code is focused on event handling and reporting functions related to order and review events.
